official: 火災予防条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会 提出議案と議決結果

name: サウナ設備と調理器具の防火基準を変更
summary: 現在の条例では、サウナ設備を種類ごとに分けていません。この議案では一般サウナ設備と簡易サウナ設備に分け、簡易サウナ設備の基準を定めます。調理器具の周りの排気ダクトなどに油脂が付かないよう管理する規定も加え、こちらは2027年4月1日から施行します。
changes: サウナ設備を一般サウナ設備と簡易サウナ設備に分ける
簡易サウナ設備に手動・自動の熱源遮断装置を求め、まき式には消火器を置く場合の例外を設ける
調理器具の周りの排気ダクトなどに油脂が付かないよう管理する
who: サウナ設備を設ける人や事業者
調理器具の周りの排気ダクトなどを管理する人や事業者
why: 国の省令の施行に伴い、サウナ設備の設置や管理の基準を改める必要があるためと、都知事は説明しています。

en.name: Changes fire safety standards for sauna equipment and cooking appliances
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Fire Prevention Ordinance
en.summary: The current ordinance does not distinguish between types of sauna equipment. This bill divides sauna equipment into general sauna equipment and simple sauna equipment, and sets standards for simple sauna equipment. It also adds a provision requiring people to manage exhaust ducts and other areas around cooking appliances to prevent grease from accumulating on them. This provision will take effect on April 1, 2027.
changes: Divides sauna equipment into general sauna equipment and simple sauna equipment
Requires simple sauna equipment to have a manual or automatic heat-source shutoff device, and allows an exception for wood-fired equipment when a fire extinguisher is provided
Requires people to manage exhaust ducts and other areas around cooking appliances to prevent grease from accumulating on them
who: People and businesses that install sauna equipment
People and businesses that manage exhaust ducts and other areas around cooking appliances
en.why: The governor says the standards for installing and managing sauna equipment need to be revised following the enforcement of a national ministerial ordinance.
